leadText: Lily (Japanese: リリー Lily) is a minor recurring character in . She is a Pokémon Performer.
plainText:
Lily (Japanese: リリー Lily) is a minor recurring character in . She is a Pokémon Performer.

==History==
Lily first appeared in A Performance Pop Quiz!, where she competed in the Anistar City Pokémon Showcase Rookie Class. For the first round, she was placed in a group with and Nini, with the theme of the round being a Pokémon quiz. She and her didn't manage to win, as Serena proceeded to the Freestyle Performance.

In A Dancing Debut!, Lily competed in the Showcase Rookie Class and lost the Theme Performance.

In Party Dancecapades!, Lily attended a dance party hosted by Monsieur Pierre.

In Master Class Is in Session!, Lily competed in the Pokémon Showcase Master Class, but she was eliminated before the semifinals.
